learning_outcomes.text: Learns the structure, properties and types of polymer materials.
Learns the methods of shaping polymer materials.

Gains the ability to design various molds using modern methods under realistic constraints and conditions to obtain products from polymer materials and to analyze the production to be made with these molds.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION TO THE COURSE AND INTRODUCTION OF POLYMER MATERIALS - Introduction to the Course - Definition of Polymer Materials - Classification of Polymer Materials - Properties of Polymer Materials
PLASTIC MATERIALS - Historical Development of Plastic Materials - Structure and Properties of Plastic Materials - Classification of Plastic Materials - Additives Used in Plastic Materials
OBTAINING PRODUCTS FROM POLYMER MATERIALS - Products Obtained from Polymers - Design Criteria for Products Made from Polymers
METHODS OF OBTAINING PRODUCTS FROM POLYMER MATERIALS - Molding methods - Extrusion methods - Rolling (calendering) methods - Machining methods - Other methods
FORMING POLYMER MATERIALS USING THE EXTRUSION METHOD - Description of Extrusion Method - Equipment Used in Extrusion Method - Analysis of Extrusion
FORMING POLYMER MATERIALS USING THE EXTRUSION METHOD (continued) - Mold Features and Extruded Products - Extrusion Errors - An example application

FORMING OF POLYMER MATERIALS USING THE TRANSFER MOLDING METHOD - Description of Transfer Molding Method - Types of Transfer Molds - Features of Transfer Molding Method - Materials Shaped with Transfer Molds - Materials of Transfer Mold Elements - Design of Transfer Molds - An example application

FORMING OF POLYMER MATERIALS USING THE PRESS MOLDING METHOD - Definition of Press (Compression) Molding Method - Advantages of Press (Compression) Molding Method - Press (Compression) Mold Types - Heating of Press Molds

FORMING OF POLYMER MATERIALS USING THE PRESS MOLDING METHOD (Continued) - Materials Shaped by Press (Compression) Molds - Press (Compression) Mold Materials - Design of Press (Compression) Molds - An example application

INJECTION CLIP OF POLYMER MATERIALS. SHAPING BY METHOD - Description of Injection Molding Method - Advantages and Disadvantages of the Injection Method - Application of Injection Molding Method - Injection Mold - Injection Mold Types - Design of Injection Molds - An example application

INJECTION MOLDING PARAMETERS - Injection Method - Shrinkage Margin and Slope Angle in Injection Method - Errors Seen in Injection Molding - Different Injection Molding Methods - Machines Used in Injection Method - Polymers Used in the Injection Method
PLASTIC BLOW MOLDING METHOD - Definition and Types of the Method - Extrusion Blow Molding Method - Injection Blow Molding Method - An example application
PLASTIC ROTATION MOLDING METHOD - Definition and Types of the Method - Materials that can be shaped by the method - An example application
teaching_methods: Lecturing with classroom whiteboards and digital presentations

Crawford R.J., Plastic Engineering, Butterworth-Heinemann, Oxford, 2002.
Çakır Şencan A., Plastic Injection and Press Molds Design Lecture Notes, Zonguldak Bülent Ecevit University, 2020.
